text: Siobhan's knee operation is on Thursday at 8am. Her husband is driving her in, so I'm collecting her the next day when she's discharged.
Marcus got the promotion! Team lead from the start of November. He says his boss told him on Friday afternoon.
Khadija has her driving test on the 12th at half 9. She's failed twice already and is properly nervous this time. Remind me to text her good luck the night before.
Agnieszka starts at the new firm on Monday. She's been at the bank for eleven years, so it's a big change for her.
Coffee with Tariq this morning. His dad's back in hospital with a chest infection and they're hoping he'll be home by the weekend.
Need to pick up the prescription before 6 and book the dentist for some time next week.
Siddharth's results day is Thursday. He thinks the maths paper went badly but the rest were fine. I should ring him that afternoon to see how he got on.
Emil is retiring at Christmas after thirty years at the council. His leaving do is on the 19th at the Red Lion, and Grace is collecting for a present.
Grace mentioned she'd love a decent pair of gardening gloves. Hers have holes in both thumbs.
Santiago's audition for the conservatory is tomorrow morning at 10. He sounded calm on the phone but his mum says he hasn't slept properly all week.
Afua had her gallbladder out last Tuesday. Recovery is slower than she expected and she's still off work. Don't forget to drop round some soup on Saturday.
Ben and his wife Saanvi both start new jobs on the same Monday, the 3rd. Their kids are going to their grandma's for the week to make it easier.
Lovely chat with Anya. She's training for her first half marathon and has gone vegan since the summer.
Ignacio's MRI got cancelled again, so the follow-up with the consultant on Friday is off as well. He's fed up.
Luis passed his theory test this morning! The practical is booked for the 28th at 2pm. Must send him a message the day before.
Matteo, or Teo as everyone calls him, finishes at the restaurant on Sunday. He's opening his own café in the spring.
Stefan told me his mum has a hip replacement booked for the 5th. He's taking a week off afterwards to look after her, and he seems really worn out already.
Nina is a nurse at St Thomas'. Lives in Brixton with her partner and a cat called Pickle.
Finn has his first day at the garage on Wednesday at 7:30. Remind me to ask him on Wednesday evening how it went.
Isla's piano grade 6 exam is next Saturday at 11. She's been practising for hours every day and is a bundle of nerves.
Teresa came out of surgery fine last night. Her daughter Nora says she should be moved off the ward on Thursday and home a few days after that.
Kiri got made redundant on Friday. She was very matter of fact about it but I could tell she's shaken. Need to call her this week.
Vanessa mentioned she's after a proper fountain pen for her new office. Might be a nice thing to get her when she starts in January.
Big week. Hassan has his citizenship test on Tuesday at 9, his sister Jada has her wisdom teeth out on Wednesday, and he's covering her shifts for the rest of the week afterwards.
Julien's cardiology appointment is on the 14th at 4:15. He's worried it'll be bad news. I should check in with him that evening.
Rahul is leaving his job at the end of the month. Says he's going travelling for six months, starting with Vietnam in December.
Sadia's CT scan came back clear! She's been on edge about it since August.
Mrs Morris from next door had a fall yesterday and is in A&E. Her son is on his way down from Leeds.
Alice starts her teacher training placement on Monday. She's nervous about standing in front of thirty Year 9s. Text her Sunday night to wish her luck, and ask how it went the Friday after.
Note to self: I'm taking Siobhan to her physio on Tuesday at 2. Leave by 1:15.
Marcus mentioned his brother Tariq has an interview at the hospital next Thursday morning. Apparently it's for a senior registrar post.
Khadija passed! Third time lucky. Her instructor cried, apparently. Must get her a card and maybe a keyring for the new car.
Agnieszka's first week went well. Her manager is lovely, but the commute is an hour each way and she's exhausted.
Grocery run tonight. Oat milk, eggs, bin bags. Also cancel the gym membership before the 1st.
Saanvi's grandad is having a pacemaker fitted on Friday at 3pm. She's flying out to Delhi the day before to be with the family.
Finn said his partner Isla got into the national youth choir. The first residential is over half term.
Emil's wife Teresa has her retirement lunch on the same day as his. They're going to Lisbon the week after to celebrate.
Rang Ignacio. His new date for the MRI is the 21st at half 8, and he sees the consultant a week after.
Santiago didn't get the conservatory place. He was gutted but has a second audition in Manchester on the 9th. I should message him before then to say I'm thinking of him.
Luis's mum is in hospital having her appendix out. He's going straight there after work.
Matteo loves old Italian films and collects vinyl, mostly jazz. Good to know for his birthday in March.
Nina's on night shifts all this month, so no point texting her before noon.
Dr Hughes said the stitches come out in ten days and I'm to rest until then. Follow-up booked for the 30th at 10:40.
Vanessa got the head of department job! She starts the new role after Easter. Her husband Ben is planning a surprise dinner on Saturday night, and I'm doing the dessert.
Hassan's citizenship test went well, he thinks. Results in two weeks. Jada's recovering but very swollen and living on yoghurt.
Talked to Kiri again. She has an interview on Monday afternoon at 2 with a charity in town, and she's feeling a bit more positive.
Stefan's mum's hip operation was postponed because of a bed shortage. They haven't given a new date yet. Remind me to ring Stefan at the weekend.
Afua is back at work part time from Monday. She's still tired by the afternoon, so mornings only for now.
Rahul's leaving drinks are on Friday the 31st, from 6 at the Crown. Bring cash for the collection.
Julien's appointment went fine. Nothing serious, just a change of medication. He sounded so relieved.

Long talk with Sadia tonight. Her brother Siddharth got his results and missed his firm offer by one grade, so he's going through clearing tomorrow morning. Her parents are taking it worse than he is. She's also sitting her own final accountancy exam on the 18th at 9 and hasn't had a minute to revise. I need to check on her the day before and see if she wants me to take Sid out for lunch afterwards.
Alice is allergic to nuts, and Uncle Luis mentioned she has her A level mocks the week after half term.
Teresa is home now. Her daughter Nora is staying with her for the first fortnight, then her son takes over.
Anya's half marathon is on Sunday morning. Her race number is 2041 apparently. Should text her that evening to ask her time.
Siobhan's knee is healing well. She's off crutches and wants to go back to work on the 2nd.

Gracie, sorry, Grace Thomas, has her nursing finals on Wednesday and Thursday mornings. She's quite stressed and her dog Biscuit is having surgery the same week, which isn't helping. Don't forget to send her a good luck message on Tuesday night.
Remember the car MOT is on Thursday at 8:30. Drop it off and walk to work.
Isla's piano exam was cancelled because the examiner was ill. It's been moved to the 22nd at 1pm.
Khadija's sister has her driving test next week too. Khadija says she's much calmer about it than she was.
Called Kiri the day after her interview. She got a second round on Thursday at 11! I'll ring her that night to find out how it went.
